scope: Scalar/RGB coverage diagnostic in linear numerical coordinates. FXAA12 official shader, default quality parameters, Rec709 luma in alpha. coverage4 uses geometry at four rotated samples, not a measured full MSAA renderer. Disk/ring/corner/checker/sine reference uses 32x32 midpoint quadrature. Straight edges/strips exact. ROI excludes 4px image boundary. No candidate receives geometric data. CONV subset uses phase .375 only; do not compare its aggregate to full-phase aggregates.
